pairs.question: Cur non comedistis hostiam pro peccato in loco sancto quae sancta sanctorum est et data vobis ut portetis iniquitatem multitudinis et rogetis pro ea in conspectu Domini praesertim cum de sanguine illius non sit inlatum intra sancta et comedere eam debueritis in sanctuario sicut praeceptum est mihi?
pairs.answer: Oblata est hodie victima pro peccato et holocaustum coram Domino mihi autem accidit quod vides quomodo potui comedere eam aut placere Domino in caerimoniis mente lugubri.
pairs.derivation: Moses asks Aaron's surviving sons (Eleazar and Ithamar) a genuine cur-interrogative about why they failed to eat the sin-offering; Aaron answers. Question = Moses's contiguous utterance across vv.17-18, with the speech tag dropped from v.16 ("iratusque contra Eleazar et Ithamar filios Aaron qui remanserant ait") and the inline verse number 18 removed; first word capitalized, ? added. Answer = Aaron's reply in v.19 with the speech tag "respondit Aaron" dropped; no non-answering preamble (the whole reply explains the circumstance and so answers the question), first word capitalized.

pairs.question: Quid comedemus anno septimo si non seruerimus neque collegerimus fruges nostras?
pairs.answer: Dabo benedictionem meam vobis anno sexto et faciet fructus trium annorum.
pairs.derivation: An anticipated question of the people, posed and answered by God. Question taken from v.20, dropping the framing "quod si dixeritis" (narration of the asking, = 'if you say'); first word capitalized, ? added. Answer = God's reply in v.21; what follows in v.22 ("seretisque anno octavo...") elaborates on later years and so is cut, leaving the operative answering sentence.
